## Interfaces

`skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md` defines per-wave task branch `task/<phase-slug>/<task-slug>` and worktree `<repo>/.worktrees/<phase-slug>--<task-slug>` (verification task excepted), re-dispatch reuse with conditional `phase/<phase-slug>` merge into the task branch, per-task commit/verify in the task worktree, wave-end `git merge` in task-slug order with conflict → unresolved markers, blocking `project:continuity-question` (`scope: merge:<task-slug>`), and hold next wave; orientation/write-root and no-Landing rules preserved. `skills/execute-phase/references/phase-end.md` adds R22/R23 prose after phase-branch merge to `main` and before phase/store close steps. `tests/test_task_worktrees.py` substring-locks R1–R26 in SKILL/phase-end; `tests/test_task_commit.py` locks task-worktree commit path (R27) and landing commit conventions.

## Assumptions

Verification task is identified as the work-item that `depends_on` every other phase work-item; parent interprets “verify-work runs in that task worktree” as using that path as check cwd; wave-start bash blocks are illustrative and gated by surrounding “only when missing” prose; phase-end cleanup is prose-only (no `git worktree remove` / branch-delete snippets).

## Invariants

R1–R21 and R24–R26 present verbatim (or equivalent) in flattened SKILL text per `test_task_worktrees.py`; R22–R23 in flattened phase-end text; R27 enforced via task-worktree `git -C … commit` assertion; landing/store/phase-close sentences retained (`test_execute_landing.py` green); design decisions (task-worktree, task-commit-evidence) reflected in skill text; no code/runtime changes beyond skills and tests.
